create.name: Renee Baribeau
create.bio:
Renee Baribeau, known as The Practical Shaman, is an American shamanic practitioner, author and teacher with around three decades of practice. She has drawn on teachings from Q'ero, Lakota, Mapuche and other Andean traditions, and since 2010 has taught her own system, WindWork, at festivals such as Bhakti Fest and Shakti Fest, at Omega and online. WindWork treats the winds as a compass for times of change: students learn to read four primary winds and the gates between them, and to use ceremony, journeying and simple rituals such as wind knots and prayer flags in everyday life.

Her Hay House book Winds of Spirit won a Nautilus Gold award, and she has since published A Pilgrim's Guide to Walking Wisdom and the 64-card Wind Walker's Wisdom Oracle; a further book, The Practical Shaman, is due from Destiny Books in 2027. She teaches through on-demand courses and monthly online journey circles on windwork.org, leads walking pilgrimages, and offers two WindWork courses on The Shift Network. She co-hosts The Shaman's Cave podcast with Sandra Ingerman and hosts her own podcast, The Practical Shaman.

books.title: Winds of Spirit: Ancient Wisdom Tools for Navigating Relationships, Health, and the Divine
books.author: Renee Baribeau
books.description: Her Hay House book introducing WindWork, a system for reading the winds as guides through change. It gathers wind lore from cultures around the world with practical rituals and exercises, and won a Nautilus Gold award.

books.title: A Pilgrim's Guide to Walking Wisdom: 11:11 Insights
books.author: Renee Baribeau
books.description: A short guide drawn from pilgrimage and walking practice, offering reflections and simple tools for moving through life's transitions. Published in 2025.

books.title: Wind Walker's Wisdom Oracle: 64-Card Shamanic Oracle Deck
books.author: Renee Baribeau
books.description: A 64-card oracle deck with guidebook based on wind spirits from cultures around the world. It is designed for reflection on direction, purpose and choices.

courses.title: WindWork
courses.description: A self-paced seven-module course on The Shift Network using wind-based journeys, ceremonies and rituals for finding direction during change. It teaches the four primary winds and the gates between them, with practices for clearing mental clutter and releasing unfinished endings.

courses.title: Become a Wind Alchemist
courses.description: A self-paced seven-module course on The Shift Network on mapping your life with the winds. It covers wind spirits, working with time and the cycles of creativity.

courses.title: Wind Work Basics 4 Modules
courses.description: An introductory home-study course based on Winds of Spirit. Students build a wind altar, take a personal inventory and learn to orient themselves using the winds.

courses.title: The Oracle of the Winds: A 12-Session Journey into Wind Walker's Wisdom
courses.description: Twelve recorded teaching sessions, taken at your own pace, on working with the Wind Walker's Wisdom Oracle. It covers reading the cards, working with the winds and building intuitive discernment; the deck is bought separately.

courses.title: The Winds of Abundance
courses.description: A home-study workshop applying simple WindWork tools to manifesting goals. It includes a guided windfall journey and worksheets on beliefs about abundance.

courses.title: Wind Knots: Power & Prosperity
courses.description: A recorded talk and ceremony on the old seafaring craft of tying wind knots, traced to Lapland, Shetland and the Isle of Man. Students learn to make their own strand of knots.

courses.title: Wind Flags for Peace & Prosperity
courses.description: A home-study course on making prayer flags with the winds and aligning with the cyclical rhythm of your life. The flags themselves are sold separately.

courses.title: The Gifts We Didn't Expect: A Gratitude Journey Circle
courses.description: A live 90-minute online WindWork journey circle on gratitude and what has sustained us through the year. No journeying experience is needed.

free_resources.title: Take Your Bearings: What's Still Yours to Carry Forward? (free replay)
free_resources.description: A recorded one-hour class using the winds to look back over the year, sort what is still yours to carry and set a direction for what comes next. The replay is free after an email sign-up.

free_resources.title: What Direction Are You Standing In Right Now?
free_resources.description: A short free quiz, offered from her website as a free oracle reading, that points to the wind direction most present in your life now. It is a light introduction to WindWork.
